preconditions.description: n is an even integer between 2 and 100 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: len(s) == n and all(c in 'abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz' for c in s)
preconditions.description: s is a string of length n consisting of lowercase Latin letters.

preconditions.expression: len(b) == n and all(1 <= bi <= 100 for bi in b)
preconditions.description: b is a list of n integers, each between 1 and 100 inclusive.
The frequency of each character in s is even, ensuring an antipalindromic permutation exists.

postconditions.expression: stdout == str(max(sum(b[i] for i in range(n) if s[i] == t[i]) for t in permutations(s) if is_antipalindromic(t)))
postconditions.description: stdout is the maximum possible beauty of any antipalindromic permutation t of s, where beauty is the sum of b[i] for all indices i where s[i] == t[i].
stdout is a non-negative integer representing the maximum beauty.
